40.title: Stream the monthly export
40.body: The March export ran out of memory on the big tenant. This streams rows instead of building the whole CSV first. The old voided-invoice test went with the rewrite; the new test covers the month filter.
40.author: export-dev
40.head: perf/stream-export

31.body: Thanks. For the record: voided invoices must never reach the accountant's export. They are legally void and the accountant files whatever is in that CSV (FIN-88).
